transverse_myelitis.description: Patients with transverse myelitis, unspecified myelitis, or neuromyelitis optica based on diagnosis evidence.

items.rationale: The concept 'Myelitis' (SNOMED ID: 138965) represents the clinical description of transverse myelitis and unspecified myelitis. While it includes other types of myelitis, it is the most appropriate standard concept available that captures the intended clinical meaning.

The concept 'Neuromyelitis optica' (SNOMED ID: 380995) directly matches the clinical description of neuromyelitis optica. It is included without including descendants as the condition is specific and distinct.
